scope: ADR-0087: add CHANGELOG.md merge=union to the existing .gitattributes (the two append-only logs were already union via the bare log.jsonl rule), so the third shared file every PR edits stops conflicting on the second+ merge. Purely additive to .gitattributes (no existing rule removed - an earlier near-clobber was caught and reverted). union stays scoped to accumulating text, never source code. Proven by a discrimination test (union resolves two appends, the same merge conflicts without it, git check-attr confirms all three real paths resolve to merge=union).

boundary.evidence: repo merge-config; union added only to CHANGELOG.md beside the existing log.jsonl rule - scoped to accumulating text, not code.

ownership.evidence: single owner (the committed .gitattributes); the diff vs origin/main is purely additive, every pre-existing rule (* text=auto, *.sh eol=lf, log.jsonl merge=union, the eol=lf shebang rules) retained.

dependency.evidence: n/a - static config; union is a built-in git driver, no per-clone config needed.

error-handling.evidence: n/a - config; the union driver cannot 'fail' - worst case is a duplicate line, which does not arise here (distinct per-PR entries).

ownership.evidence: n/a - test; owns no production state.

dependency.evidence: n/a - spawns git in a throwaway repo; skips if git is unavailable.

error-handling.evidence: the WITHOUT-union control asserts the merge conflicts, so the test fails if the attribute is dropped; git check-attr confirms resolution for all three real paths.
